moot_wind.text: (placeholder) One of the Four Winds. The story agent writes the Moot gauntlet here.

moot_centre.text: (placeholder) The Champion of the Moot waits in the centre of the circle.

kit_moot.text: (placeholder) Kit, at the gates of the Moot.

moot_visitor.text: The big stones here are sarsens, and they came from about 25 miles away. The smaller bluestones came from Wales, 150 miles off. How? Nobody's quite sure, which makes it one of the best mysteries in Britain.
The Moot gathers here. I'm not supposed to say that. It's what the inside of the Visitor Centre says. Quietly.

moot_picnic.text: I sat down for a sandwich and the stones hummed. I'm a scientist, so I'm calling it 'acoustics'.
On midsummer morning the sun comes up right through the Avenue, and everyone cheers. It's the best sunrise party in Britain, and the dress code is 'wrapped up warm'.
